_comment: Starter questions shown in the empty chat state, grouped into chapters (module-development themes). Each is grounded in classes/mixins that exist in the indexed API reference. Edit freely; the UI reads this file at load.

chapters.title: Module basics
questions: What is the minimal structure of a Metasploit module, and which superclass do I choose for an exploit vs. auxiliary vs. post?
How do I fill in update_info (Name, Description, Author, License, References, DisclosureDate) in initialize?
How do I register datastore options with register_options, and read them with datastore[...] at runtime?
What do OptString, OptInt, OptBool, OptEnum, OptPort and OptAddressRange do, and when should I use each?
How do print_status, print_good, print_error and vprint_* work, and when is each appropriate?
How do I use fail_with and Msf::Exploit::Failure to abort a module with a clear reason?

chapters.title: Writing an exploit
questions: Write a skeleton Msf::Exploit::Remote module with a check method and an exploit method, and explain each part.
Which Msf::Exploit::Remote::* mixins exist and what does each one provide?
How do I define targets and use the target['...'] / target.ret values in an exploit?
How do I build and send a payload with payload.encoded, and how do handlers work?
How do I implement a reliable check() that returns CheckCode values?
How do I use Msf::Exploit::CmdStager to deliver a command-line payload?

chapters.title: HTTP / web
questions: Write a minimal Msf::Auxiliary HTTP scanner that GETs a path and reports a vuln when the body contains a marker.
How do I use send_request_cgi and send_request_raw from the HttpClient mixin, and what does the Response object expose?
How do I handle cookies, authentication and redirects with the HttpClient mixin?
How do I register and use RHOST, RPORT, SSL, VHOST and TARGETURI for an HTTP module?
How do I normalize a TARGETURI path safely before requesting it?
How do I detect a web technology or version from HTTP response headers in a module?

chapters.title: Auxiliary & scanners
questions: What does the Msf::Auxiliary::Scanner mixin give me, and how do run_host and run_range differ?
Write an auxiliary scanner using the Scanner mixin that checks many hosts concurrently.
How do I add a login scanner with Msf::Auxiliary::AuthBrute and Metasploit::Framework::LoginScanner?
How do I use Msf::Auxiliary::Report to record hosts, services and vulns?
How do I iterate credentials and handle success/failure in a brute-force auxiliary module?
How do I write a simple capture/server auxiliary module that collects credentials?

chapters.title: Sockets & protocols
questions: How do I open a raw TCP connection with the Tcp mixin (connect, sock, disconnect) and read/write data?
What does Rex::Socket provide, and how do I create a TCP or UDP socket directly?
How do I use the Udp mixin to send and receive datagrams in a module?
How do I set timeouts and handle Rex socket exceptions cleanly?
How do I work with SSL/TLS sockets in a Metasploit module?
How do I build and parse a custom binary protocol using Rex?

chapters.title: SMB & Windows services
questions: How do I use the SMB client mixins to connect and authenticate to a share?
How do I enumerate shares or files over SMB from an auxiliary module?
How do I use the RubySMB / Rex SMB classes the framework ships with?
How do I handle NTLM authentication and hashes in an SMB module?
How do I use the DCERPC mixin to call a remote procedure?
How do I write an SMB relay or capture module using the NTLM classes?

chapters.title: Active Directory & Kerberos
questions: What Kerberos classes does the framework provide, and how do I request a TGT/TGS from a module?
How do I use the LDAP mixin to query Active Directory from an auxiliary module?
How do I perform Kerberos authentication (AS-REQ / TGS-REQ) with the Rex Kerberos classes?
How do I forge or inspect Kerberos tickets with the framework's helpers?
How do I work with keytabs and credential caches (ccache) in code?
How do I enumerate AD CS certificate templates using the shipped classes?

chapters.title: Database services
questions: How do I use the MSSQL mixin to connect, authenticate and run a query?
How do I use the MySQL client classes to authenticate and send a query?
How do I use the PostgreSQL client classes from an auxiliary module?
How do I run xp_cmdshell or enable it safely from an MSSQL module?
How do I handle database errors and report results back to the user?
How do I enumerate databases, tables and users over MSSQL/MySQL/PostgreSQL?

chapters.title: Post-exploitation & sessions
questions: Write a skeleton Msf::Post module with a run method that reads a session and prints system info.
How do I use the Msf::Post::File mixin to read, write and check files on a session?
How do I run a command on a session and capture its output (cmd_exec, session.sys)?
How do I use Msf::Post::Windows::* helpers for registry, accounts and privileges?
How do I detect the session platform and architecture before acting?
How do I use Msf::Exploit::Powershell to run PowerShell in a post module?

chapters.title: Payloads & encoders
questions: How do payloads work internally (Payload, EncodedPayload) and how is a payload selected for a target?
How do I generate and encode a payload in code, and what is the handler's role?
How do I write or use an encoder, and what are BadChars?
How do Meterpreter extensions expose functionality to a post module?
How do I use a CmdStager to stage a larger payload over a limited command channel?
What is the difference between staged and stageless payloads, in the API's terms?

chapters.title: Reporting, loot & creds
questions: How do I use report_vuln, report_service and report_host to record findings in the database?
How do I use store_loot to save captured data, and where does it go?
How do I store credentials with create_credential and the Metasploit::Credential classes?
How do I attach a reference (CVE, URL) to a reported vuln?
What is the difference between report_* helpers and the Msf::Auxiliary::Report mixin?
How do I query previously stored hosts/services from within a module?

chapters.title: Explore the API
questions: Which mixins does Msf::Exploit::Remote::HttpClient include, and what methods does it add?
List the most useful methods on Rex::Socket and what each does.
What classes live under the Msf::Post namespace, grouped by platform?
Compare the HttpClient and Tcp mixins: when would I use each?
What does the Msf::Auxiliary::Scanner module expose, method by method?
Give me an overview of the Rex::Proto protocol implementations available.
